sources.locator: Complete 106-page course-note PDF retrieved. Read Chapter 5 §5.2.6 (PDF pp. 79–82) and §5.2.2 (PDF p. 70), including the complete volume-potential and far-field passages.
sources.source_kind_detail: Full author-hosted inverse-problems lecture-note PDF; source supports scattering conventions and scope, while all L2 operator estimates are proved locally.

contents.name: §5.2.6 Lippmann–Schwinger equation, volume potential, and outgoing Green function (PDF pp. 79–82)
contents.detail: Read the complete derivation of the volume equation and radiation convention. Their physical uniqueness theorem uses unique continuation and is not imported; all operator estimates and the distributional normalization are proved locally.

contents.name: §5.2.2 far-field mapping (PDF p. 70)
contents.detail: Read the stated far-field mapping and checked the local volume-potential asymptotic separately.

contents.name: Theorem 5.30 uniqueness route via unique continuation
contents.detail: The planned claim assumes injectivity and does not assert outgoing-PDE uniqueness for arbitrary contrasts; no unique-continuation premise is imported.

sources.title: Pierre Capel, Introduction to Scattering Theory, TALENT lecture notes

sources.source_kind_detail: Full TALENT lecture-note PDF on scattering theory; used for partial-wave conventions and radial matching.

contents.name: Spherical harmonics and partial-wave decomposition (PDF pp. 17–21)
contents.detail: Read the complete harmonic and plane-wave discussion; local proofs supply completeness, addition-kernel bounds, and the fixed-cutoff estimate.

contents.name: Spherical Bessel radial equation, recurrence, and regular solution (PDF pp. 18–21)
contents.detail: Read the radial ODE and recurrence discussion. The local convention fixes outgoing h_l^(1) from e^(iz)/z and proves the symbolic identities.

contents.name: Radial matching and square-well example (PDF pp. 29–33)
contents.detail: Read the boundary matching reasoning and verified the local ell=0 formula directly.

contents.name: Printed spherical Neumann n_0 sign convention
contents.detail: Capel prints n_0=+cos(z)/z, opposite the standard convention used in the other treatment; no Capel Neumann sign is imported.

sources.source_kind_detail: Full author-hosted quantum-theory course PDF; used as the independent partial-wave and square-well treatment.

contents.name: Chapter 8 partial-wave expansion and spherical harmonics (PDF pp. 141–150)
contents.detail: Read the complete chapter discussion used for radial conventions and expansion; the local harmonic proof and cutoff estimate give the required details.

contents.name: Radial equation and square-well matching (PDF pp. 151–153)
contents.detail: Read the full square-well matching derivation and recomputed both continuity equations locally.

contents.name: Lippmann–Schwinger convention (PDF pp. 155–156)
contents.detail: Read the convention and matched q=k^2(n−1) to the explicitly stated sign in the local model.

sources.source_kind_detail: Full author-hosted integral-equations and boundary-value lecture-note PDF; its generic theorem is separated from its one-dimensional point-sampling instance.

contents.name: §3.3 generic collectively compact stability and solution error (printed pp. 60–64; PDF pp. 61–65)
contents.detail: Read the full generic theorem and proof route. The local theorem verifies Banachness, pointwise projection convergence, and collective compactness for L2(D) before applying it.

contents.name: Method 3.12 and Theorem 3.19 point-sampling Nyström scheme on C([0,1])
contents.detail: The source-specific rule is one-dimensional and acts on C([0,1]); it is not generalized. This batch uses exact 3D cell-pair integrals and only the generic stability theorem.

contents.name: §1.3 Neumann-series inverse and solution error (printed pp. 10–12)
contents.detail: Read the full geometric-series argument; the local item supplies the convergence and truncation tail on complex L2(D).

contents.name: §1.3 collectively compact Fredholm stability (Theorems 1.7–1.8, printed pp. 12–13)
contents.detail: Read the stated generic stability framework and compare its hypotheses with the actual batch48 theorem and local volume projections.

contents.name: Theorem 1.9 printed error sign versus its proof
contents.detail: The statement prints f_n+f while the proof derives f_n−f. No reliance is placed on that theorem statement; the local error estimate uses the current batch48 supplier.
